phrase: The AI companies promised to police themselves on safety. They were so eager that they misspelled the name of the country they promised it to.
phraseAlternatives: Dozens of AI companies promised to watch themselves closely. They watched so closely they misspelled their own country's name.
A new AI safety deal has no law and no deadline, just one typo in the country's name.
Tech leaders signed a pledge to grade their own AI safety homework. The homework already has a spelling mistake.
The government let AI companies police themselves. The first thing they got wrong was the country's name.
alt: Two blueprint-style robots stand well apart and link their inner pinky fingers over a small desk between them. Above, a tall pledge document reads PLEDGE, then UNITED and ZTATES, with ZTATES glowing in bright yellow to show the misspelling.

brief.concept: Two robot executives seal a voluntary AI safety pledge with a pinky-swear, while the formal document behind them has a glaring typo.
brief.metaphor: A solemn oath reduced to a children's pinky-swear, undercut by a careless misspelling on the official paperwork.
cast: a second robot in a suit
brief.composition: Centered: two suited robot figures facing each other, linking pinky fingers over a desk. Behind them, a large upright document with bold header text, one word circled in a yellow highlight showing a misspelling. A tiny government-building icon sits small in the background corner. Clean white linework on blueprint-blue grid, deadpan and symmetrical.
brief.alt: Two suited robot figures link pinky fingers over a desk. Behind them stands a signed pledge document with one word circled in yellow, misspelled as 'UNITED ZTATES'.
